context_requirements: Expression of the relevant calcium channel or calcium-sensing receptor (CACNA1C, CACNA1S, or CASR)
Intact calcium-dependent signaling machinery (calmodulin, calcineurin, CaMKs, and downstream transcription factors such as CREB and NFAT)
Appropriate membrane potential and ionic gradients to permit channel activation
falsifiers: No consistent change in any of the proximal_up genes at 6 h across cell lines
Absence of any transcriptional response (all genes unchanged) at both 6 h and 24 h
A response pattern indistinguishable from generic stress or proliferation programs without calcium-dependent immediate early gene induction
